core_obligations: Set up the valuative diagram: take a valuation ring with field of fractions, a morphism from the fraction field to the source and a compatible morphism from the ring to the target (proof lines 9788-9793)

Reformulate by base change: the category of dotted arrows behaves well under the base change that replaces the target by the spectrum of the valuation ring, so the problem reduces to a diagram over a valuation ring with the target the spectrum of that ring (proof lines 9794-9820)
Apply the existence clause of the criterion in the reduced situation and conclude universal closedness from the corresponding statement (proof lines 9821-9836)
proof_roadmap: 取赋值环 A（分式域 K）与使外方块 2-交换的 x、y、γ。
用「点箭头的范畴在基变换下不变」把图约化到目标就是 Spec(A) 的情形。
由存在性假设得到点箭头，再由与该情形对应的命题得一致闭。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks which satisfies the existence clause of the valuative criterion is universally closed (author lemma at source lines 9777-9786, label lemma-converse-existence-universally-closed). The proof (source lines 9788-9837) sets up the valuative diagram with a valuation ring, uses the base change behaviour of the category of dotted arrows to reduce the diagram, and obtains the dotted arrow from the hypothesis before concluding by the corresponding statement for the reduced situation (proof lines 9788-9836). The reduction of the valuative diagram and the reading of the hypothesis in the reduced form are the content. H3.
